_comment: Every check that ties the trainer to a measurement (reference recordings, the game's settings or interface, community databases) or to an adopted analysis figure, and the test files that hold it. Bands are never widened in a refactor step. basis: recordings = measured on the two reference recordings; game = the game's settings or interface; databases = values published by community databases (not verified in game); analysis = an adopted figure of the flight analysis. tests/fidelity/index.test.js checks that every id is present and tested where listed.

checks.check: roll rate after 0.5 s and 1 s of click

checks.band: 6.5-9.5 deg; drift < 2 deg over 3 s
22-30 deg nose-up
lever > 0.95, peak climb 4.5-9 m/s, gain 5-35 m, stops < 0.5 m/s; lever < -0.95, min VS -3..-9
stays down at idle, hover > 8 m after Z 1.2 s

checks.check: top speed at 13 deg nose-down, lever saturates, sinks

checks.band: > 50 m, > 150 km/h bled, lever < -0.95

checks.check: weathervane ratio; yaw at 220 km/h; bank turn altitude

checks.band: first round 0.35 +- 0.02 s, 49-51 rounds in 2.35 s, short release keeps spin
42 values, mean 58.23, sum = four on-screen totals
VS rms < 3 m/s, lever rms < 0.45, >= 8 windows, hold and body-flow terms help, drag < 0.5 x v3 error

checks.check: mouse crossing response vs the game curve (43 crossings)
checks.band: rms <= 3 deg/s, peak 0.22 +- 0.05 s, analysis 2.42 reproduced +- 0.05; p99 <= 30 deg/s; v12 stick reproduces 17.11

checks.check: nose stops after a swipe (rate law)
checks.band: < 1.5 s (stick > 2 s)

checks.check: roll replay on 467 windows and 0.1 s tap
checks.band: rms <= 7.8705, tap 5.4-9 deg, unchanged vs v12

checks.check: chase heading after D from hover (physics level and as rendered at 100 Hz)
checks.band: 7.5 +- 1.5 deg at 0.73 s, 31.6 +- 2.5 at 1.47 s; analysis figures +- 0.02; tape = camera heading

checks.check: turn ratio by speed (report, not adopted)
checks.band: unchanged vs v12 within 0.01
hover lever -0.14 +- 0.04, reset -0.14, down rate 1, Z/Shift 5 s VS within 0.3 of v12
analysis VS and 4-6 s dalt reproduced 1e-3, better than v12, cruise spd <= 1.2; named segments within v12 + 1 m / + 0.2 m/s
-8.5 +- 1 deg at 235 km/h; 27/55 km/h unchanged

checks.check: rotor and minigun spectra, report decay, rate
checks.band: <= 5 dB per octave band, loudest 120-250 Hz / 20-60 Hz, 50 % in 1-4 ms and 10 % in 15-40 ms, 30 reports/s

checks.check: cabin mix in the pilot view
checks.band: shelf < -7 dB above 4.5 kHz, rotor bus > x1.8; chase view plain

checks.check: valley relief, slopes, trees, densities, canopy, AGL over trees

hall 14-20 m, chimney 75-105 m, pylon 30-40 m, container 12.19 m, towers 32-35 m, river 1.2 m lower

checks.band: ids and order of the game's presets
85 deg horizontal, no shake, no widening in the pilot view, sight only in the cockpit, key hints worded and ordered as in the game

checks.band: AGL over a tree ~10 +- 1.5 m; roof <= 13; pad AGL 0 / ASL 84
0.02 + 0.0011 x 270 %/s +- 0.03; refuel 5 %/s; dry tank sinks
300 rounds (recording 1), boxes of 150, 2 s burst ~42 rounds, 2 flare charges
450 m/s, 20 m/s ejection, arming 0.13 s, 200/400 points, blast 10.8 m, ranges 1 000/100 m, emplacement cone > 77 deg and 3 s cycle
RPG-7 100 m/s 110/12/2.5, MAAWS 230 m/s 100, Humvee 22 HP minigun 650 m, pickup 12 HP M249 500 m
emplacement 416 hits, CIWS 694 hits, round 1/60 at 36.01, RPG-7 27.5 %, AH-6R rocket 25 %, Humvee 1.8 %/round, M249 0.8 %/round, CIWS 224 m/s 30 rds/s 15 %/hit

checks.check: mouse law through the app handlers
checks.band: steady rate = K x 500 px/s within 3 %, nose stops < 1.5 s, stick saturates > 48 deg/s, mouse + key capped at 52 deg/s
85 deg to 140 km/h, 109 +- 0.05 at 250, distance x1.11, ratio within 0.05 of game medians in 8 bands, stabiliser span ratio 0.51-0.58, spans and hub row, 0.5 s smoothing
per-frame displacement CV < 0.02 at 100 Hz for view and targets; physics unchanged
hub 1.768, stabiliser 1.721 / x 0.836, boom 0.70 at z 4.2, skids -1.25, grips 0.81 m, cowl recess z 1.215, boom top 0.93 at z 2.4, end cap z 4.985, rotor band 25-50 km/h
